title: Late-Delivery Dispute Decisions on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts: The Lateness Credit and the Excusal Mark
content:
**Clause.** On Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, a late-delivery dispute that stands submitted concerns the account's most recent late-delivery violation and is decided by the agent on the record of that violation's batch: when the lateness credit reaches the excusal mark of 4 points, the decision removes all of the points the violation was recorded with; when it falls short, it removes none. The lateness credit is the store-wait credit plus the detour credit, used as they stand whatever the number of orders on the batch, plus the store-delay credit, where the store-wait credit, the detour credit and the store-delay credit are each zero points.

**One comparison.** The lateness credit is compared with the mark of 4 points only once, after all of its parts are added.

## Decision table

| Lateness credit | Points removed |
|---|---|
| 4 points or more | All of the violation's recorded points |
| 0 to 3 points | None |

## Values entering the credit

| Part | Value |
|---|---|
| Store-wait credit | 0 points |
| Detour credit | 0 points |
| Store-delay credit | 0 points |

## Worked example (hypothetical violation)

The most recent late-delivery violation was recorded with 1 point. The lateness credit is 0 plus 0, as they stand, plus 0: 0 points. 0 does not reach 4, so the decision removes none of the recorded point: 0 points are removed.

## Boundary

A lateness credit of exactly 4 points reaches the mark and removes all of the recorded points; 3 points falls short and removes none. There is no partial removal.
